limitations.quote: The final zero also starts a possible overlapping match.
limitations.note: The edit fixed the one-cycle delay in `match` but also changed the transitions out of `s4_d0110`, allowing overlapping detections that the original and reference FSMs do not report.
The test's rolling valid-bit history expected overlapping matches, so even exhaustive eight-cycle testing could not flag the extra detections as regressions.
Two edit attempts had to be redone for reasons unrelated to the design: the patch context did not match, and the fallback used an unavailable `python` command before retrying with `python3`.
The knowledge-base search returned no hits and contributed no guidance to the fix.
